package.description: Customizable automatic UML diagram generator for C++ based on Clang.

en-US.description: Customizable automatic UML diagram generator for C++ based on Clang.
en-US.longDescription: An automatic C++ to UML class, sequence, package and include diagram generator, driven by YAML configuration files. The main idea behind the project is to easily maintain up-to-date diagrams within a code-base or document legacy code.
en-US.name: clang-uml
